column1: # False friends: Hán-Việt words whose modern Vietnamese meaning drifted from the Chinese word written with the same
# characters. Hand-curated (they cannot be detected automatically); read by tools/cards.py, which sets the card's
# label to "false-friend" (a lesson's own `label` in new_words still wins). Empty on purpose: entries are added when
# a lesson or a check finds one, each with the evidence in the note.
# Format: one word per line, three tab-separated fields:
#   word (quốc ngữ, spaces or underscores)  <TAB>  chữ Hán ('' = whatever characters the card has)  <TAB>  note (English)
